name: cf-transfer-pricing
description: Use this Central African Republic transfer pricing Guide for 2026 research on foreign controlled transactions, profit transfers, low-tax counterparties and cross-border deductions. It works through the fetched code’s control test, the privileged-tax comparison and specific limits on foreign charges and purchasing commissions. Search triggers include prix de transfert, related-party fee, thin capitalisation, management charge, royalty, non-cooperative territory and deduction cap. This is a conditional statutory baseline from the Ministry’s official 2023 edition, with unresolved later amendments and procedural requirements expressly withheld. It does not declare that master files, local files, country reporting or advance agreements are absent.
